correctness.rationale: At redundancy 2 the unitary Zak fiber is the sum of squares of two explicit three-term Laurent polynomials; each has nonnegative coefficients with middle coefficient dominating its two neighbors, hence θ=1/2 minimizes each modulus and θ=0 maximizes. The spatial extrema reduce to exact piecewise convex quadratics in physical y∈[0,a], a=1/(2b). The center and symmetric off-center stationary positions exchange at the two roots b0=2−sqrt(10)/4 and b1=(19−sqrt(10))/12. The displayed A(b)>0 three-piece and B(b) formula are continuous and sharp on every real b∈[1,3/2]. Independent direct finite-Zak evaluations corroborated sample b,y,phase; infinite continuum follows from coefficient dominance and complete envelope comparisons, not those samples.
